svg.desc: ENGRAM v2 icon sprite. Lucide-style, 24x24, 2px stroke, round caps and joins. Hand-authored, zero external origins. Usage: an svg with class "icon icon-16" containing use href="#atom". Presentation attributes are set on each symbol, because attributes on this root svg element are NOT cloned into the use shadow tree. components.css .icon also sets them via CSS (which DOES inherit into the shadow tree): belt and braces, so a bare use renders correctly either way. Same-origin use href="file.svg#id" works over http(s) but NOT over file://. Preferred boot path: fetch this file once, inject into a hidden div, then reference plain "#id". See DESIGN.md section 9. NOTE: this file must stay valid XML. XML comments may not contain a double hyphen, so all notes live in desc elements.
